title: Protected area

location.series: City of Helsinki live visual identity guidelines

slide_intent: Protect separation around the mark because neighboring elements can weaken its recognition.
strategic_value: H-based clear space can give Helsinki’s logo a consistent boundary at different scales.
demonstration: This expanded webpage section describes large and small protected areas and illustrates the larger area with two-H-height units around the logo.
practical_value: Choose the normal protected area and identify when the absolute minimum is being used.

content_islands.name: Rule
content_islands.spec: Explain that no other elements enter the protected area.

content_islands.name: Large-area diagram
content_islands.spec: Show two stacked H units and dimension arrows on all four sides of the framed logo.

ingredient.name: Logo protected area
ingredient.role: Keep surrounding content from crowding the signature.
ingredient.application: Measure clear space from outermost logo points: two H heights for the large version, one H height as the small absolute minimum.
ingredient.scope: Applies to space around the framed logo; this uses H height, not the H width used for internal construction.

reference_purposes.Application: The drawing measures the larger protected area outward from the logo’s outermost points; the text also defines the smaller minimum.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The large protected area is twice H height; the small absolute minimum is one H height.
